messages:
marta: heads-up — preparing the private/vpc onprem package cutover at 22:00 UTC. packaging artifacts are built and staged in staging-bucket.

sam: copying the checklist here: 1) cosign signatures present 2) shrinkwrap manifest pinned 3) image pin file updated 4) transport handoff window locked.

jihoon: quick note — cosign signature for `redwood-offline-installer:v2026.03.21-rc2` shows a timestamp drift on one signer. i validated chain: root ok, signer B lagging. recommend hold unless we can re-sign within 10m.

marta: ok — what's the fallout if we proceed? will clients fail to verify?

jihoon: older validators (pre-2024) may reject; our guide says expiries must be within 2h. most customers ok but some downstream airgap tooling is strict.

tanya: we also have a deploy-bot canary scheduled for 22:10 UTC. if we hold, canary will auto-abort per policy. do we want manual override? :thinking_face:

andrew: i'm leaning to hold for signer reissue. re-signning takes ~6m + cosign propagation ~3m. If we miss the window we can shift cutover by 30m.

sam: ops opt: set rollback trigger: if canary latency > 250ms or error rate > 3% for 3m, initiate immediate rollback to v2026.02.15-hotfix. add a manual gate at 10m to allow abort if signing completes.

marta: agreed. set these in the release notes and in the deploy-bot metadata. also add KMS audit link in the channel.

deploy-bot: [deploy] request received: private-vpc/installer v2026.03.21-rc2 by @marta. Canary group: staging-escort-3. Canary window: 22:10-22:40 UTC. Auto-abort policy: on success rate < 97% -> rollback.

sam: copying the command we'll run to re-sign (for on-call):
```bash
cosign sign-blob --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKey v2026.03.21-rc2/installer.tar.gz.sig
```

jihoon: i'll start re-sign now. tagging @tanya for validation.

(6m later)

jihoon: re-sign complete. cosign verification: PASS for all signers. propagation checked against mirror: sha256 matches.

marta: thanks. i'm flipping the canary to GO at 22:15 to give time for mirrors to sync. deploy-bot — please start canary on confirm.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary start confirmed at 22:15 UTC. monitoring hooks attached (trace, token-cost, latency).

andrew: note for postmortem: add a short blurb about signer TTL and clock skew in packaging docs. this bit caused the hold.

tanya: validation pass on shrinkwrap and manifest pin. transport checksum verified: `md5: 9f8a...`, `sha256: e3b0...`.

marta: excellent. leaving a final note in release notes: "Delayed start due to signer reissue; canary passed. No rollback triggered. Mirrors verified."

sam: updating the release-notes draft and the release metadata now. I will also pin the image tag in `private-pinning/rc6/pins.json`.

marta: thanks all. closing thread once release-notes PR merged. :thumbsup:
